findings.current: “Second Young Master, you aren’t going to kill me too, are you?”
findings.explanation: Hyuk Mujin is asking Taekyung whether the Second Young Master, Jin Mukyung, will kill him too; the Second Young Master is the subject of the question, not its addressee.
